notes.title: Devlog #5: One-Year Anniversary of Noxia Somnia
notes.content:
[h1]Noxia Somnia released 1 year ago today[/h1]

And we couldn't be more thankful for the community that's supported us every step of the way! Because of players like you, we've been able to continue development of the game into something bigger and better than we ever could have imagined. Which brings us to the news we have to share about Noxia Somnia: Ultimate Edition...

[h2]Updates on Ultimate Edition[/h2]
[list]
[*] With all the love and work we’ve been putting into Ultimate Edition, we feel that the game is deserving of its own Steam store page as a standalone product. This page will be going live for wishlists shortly - and we'd really appreciate if you could help spread the word once this happens!
[*] Did we mention that Ultimate Edition is a huge update? Don't just take our word for it... see for yourself in this new teaser trailer just how much the game has evolved. 
[previewyoutube=aQTEWv7_VXc;full][/previewyoutube]
[*] Everyone who buys a copy of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2278940/Noxia_Somnia/]Noxia Somnia[/url] on Steam before Ultimate Edition is released will receive a complementary version of Ultimate Edition as a thank you for your support. (PS: Noxia Somnia is also currently 30% off too!).
[*] After the release of our demo, we got some great feedback that we've put into Ultimate Edition. Players felt that Act 1 looked pretty similar in the Ultimate Edition demo to how it looked in the base game - so we’ve made massive visual upgrades to go along with the polished gameplay style. We’ve also fixed minor user experience issues that popped up, like some text boxes staying on screen too long. 
[/list]

[h2]And now, back to our regularly scheduled devlog…[/h2]

[h3]The Reaper[/h3]
[i]The Abyss. The End. He can take many names, but here, he is known as The Reaper.[/i]

The Reaper is one of the new enemies exclusive to Ultimate Edition. And we honestly think he just looks so cool, that we had to show you a preview of his combat sequence (spoilers, of course!)

[previewyoutube=piho6fbaN0o;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]More new abilities in Ultimate Edition[/h3]
We're bringing you even more ways to spice up your combat style in Ultimate Edition. 
[list]
[*] [b]Reframe[/b] is a new move exclusive to the Ultimate Nightmare difficulty mode in Ultimate Edition that lets Tristan parry an incoming attack and counter with a high-damage punch. This will be one of five new skills added to the skill tree in the Ultimate Nightmare difficulty mode.
[*] [b]Second Wind[/b] is a new ability available in all difficulties of Ultimate Edition that allows Tristan to unleash his true power.  
[/list]

[h3]Thank you for your support[/h3]
It truly means the world to us. If you have questions, feedback, or just want to say hi, we'd love to connect with you over on [url=https://bsky.app/profile/reframegames.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url]. [b]Are you a game reviewer[/b]? We're also looking to connect with folks who'd like to give their first impressions on Ultimate Edition - drop us a line at reframegamesinc [at] gmail.com if you'd be interested in getting a review copy of the game in the coming weeks.

notes.title: Devlog #4: The Level Glow Ups Continue!
notes.content:
In our last dev log, we covered the extensive rework done to Act 3 of Noxia Somnia for Ultimate Edition. Today, we’re diving into set dressing improvements for Act 1 & 2, along with some added animation and balancing highlights!

[h2]Act 1 & 2 Reworks[/h2]
You can expect the worlds of Act 1 and 2 to feel more alive than ever in Ultimate Edition!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rTPtbNe.png[/img]
[i]Better late than never for this party in Act 1![/i]

Every single room in Act 2 was reworked, including both the [spoiler]past and future[/spoiler] versions. Combined with our improved lighting system, some areas are almost unrecognizable (in the best way!). Each floor in Act 2 now has a unique wallpaper color to help players more easily recognize where they are. You’ll also be able to hear and see rain outside of windows. 

Before:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/qNQsqfM.png[/img]
After:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/l5BwBYe.png[/img]

[h2]Animations[/h2]
Tristan’s animations are getting reworked to feel more fluid and responsive.

[video]https://i.imgur.com/oynAYTX.mp4[/video]
Before:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/r4K5eZU.gif [/img]
After:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/HRfKvlG.gif [/img]


[h2]Rebalancing [/h2]
We’ve refined the game’s economy to make progression smoother and more rewarding.

[b]Item Trades[/b]
[list]
[*] We reduced item requirements for trades.
[*] Bounty trades now require fewer materials, making early summons like the Scholar more accessible.
[/list]
[b]Consumables[/b]
[list]
[*] Consumables are slightly more expensive, with steeper increases in Ultimate Nightmare mode—buy wisely!
[/list]
[b]Cosmetics[/b]
[list]
[*] All clothing items now cost a flat 30 coins, except for the newly added Gold Jacket.
[/list]
[b]Shard & Coin Drops[/b]
[list]
[*] Shard drops from enemies are reduced in early levels but increased in later levels.
[*] Coin drops have been reduced overall.
[/list]
[b]Material Drop Rates[/b]
[list]
[*] Materials now drop consistently: 70% on The Nightmare/Ultimate Nightmare and 90% on Face Your Fears. Using Lucky Tea guarantees a 100% drop rate.
[/list]
[b]Merchant Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] After completing an act, players can purchase materials for that act’s monsters directly from the merchant—though at a premium price.
[/list]
[b]Additional Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] The Greg Whistle is now free 🐈 
[*] Picking up items while at the carry limit now grants 5 coins instead of the item’s full value, for balancing.
[/list]

[h2]New-to-You Music [/h2]
[previewyoutube=QxgrbLBk56M;full][/previewyoutube]

Sleuthful players have previously asked us about [url=https://youtu.be/QxgrbLBk56M]this unused game song[/url]. A version of the song (Phase 2) did appear in 1.0, but this version was unused completely. We can reveal that this track will make an appearance in Act 4 of Ultimate Edition!

[i]Wait, Act 4?[/i]

[h2]Until Next Time[/h2]
Happy holidays from all of us at Reframe Games, and we’ll be back in the New Year with more Noxia Somnia: Ultimate Edition news soon! We’ve also recently joined [url=https://bsky.app/profile/reframegames.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url], which is a great place to stay connected with our latest updates.

notes.title: Devlog #3: Level Redesigns, Post-Game Story, and More!
notes.content:
[i]In this month’s devlog, you’ll hear from Keenan, the lead game developer on Noxia Somnia and Noxia Somnia: Ultimate Edition! [/i]

[h2]Act 3, Reimagined[/h2]
The entire level has received a facelift. The original was pretty rushed and unfinished for the game's initial release. In terms of content it was pretty solid, but on the art side I felt it wasn’t up to the quality of the rest of the game. Over the last couple weeks I've been going in and redesigning the whole thing from a visual standpoint. Improved lighting, improved sprites, and more.

Keep in mind that everything you see here is work in progress. Everything is subject to change. Let us know what you think!

[video]https://i.imgur.com/ZkDqCGu.mp4[/video]
[video]https://i.imgur.com/wV09Lsm.mp4[/video]

One of the visual ideas I wanted to implement in the act was having a lot of prison-like decor. Act 3 has always been about Tristan's fear of judgement; that by being himself he'd be mocked and bullied by the world around him. As a result of that fear he wore a mask, suppressing his identity and effectively locking it away to fit in. I've taken that idea and run with it, having large jail cells backed by a piercing red light, chains, and more to reinforce this concept.

Some of the chains hanging from the ceiling now have physics and sound as well! This has no effect on gameplay and is purely for atmosphere.

[video]https://i.imgur.com/RVN5XuX.mp4[/video]
[video]https://i.imgur.com/fo2fL2H.mp4[/video]

I've also gone in and redesigned the second half of the map; the Skylight Hall. I've decided to remove the old city background and replace it with something a bit more abstract; an ominous, glowing red sky with some gentle snowfall. I think it looks pretty good and gives the area a bit more of an oppressive atmosphere.

[video]https://i.imgur.com/JfNoEnV.mp4[/video]
[video]https://i.imgur.com/o9JAqNI.mp4[/video]

There were also a lot of rooms in the 1.0 release that were either empty, or severely lacking in detail when compared to content seen in Act 1 or 2. For example; the pharmacy in the Skylight Hall didn't have any pharmacy-like props inside of it. Just a few TVs and a couple Eye Slimes. It's safe to say this will be addressed in Ultimate Edition.

[video]https://i.imgur.com/5e7NTeH.mp4[/video]
[video]https://i.imgur.com/XrB47dz.mp4[/video]

A handful of screenshots of redesigned rooms will follow.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yuEXI1r.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/lrTMGBp.png[/img]

A few smaller changes have been made to the merchant's store. The low-hanging fog seen in some earlier footage of the game has been restored; it was bugged in 1.0 and didn't render properly. Additionally, the bounty board now has some fancy flashing LED lights and a big "TRADE" sign.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JtHicZy.png[/img]

The Boutique has received some similar treatment. I've improved the lighting significantly and added more decoration.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WAVjzy9.png[/img]

[h2]POST-GAME?[/h2]
This next section contains spoilers for the base game! If you haven't completed the game, avert your eyes! Run away! Or just skip to the next section!

[spoiler]Ultimate Nightmare mode contains post-game content. You might be wondering how, in the context of the story, does this happen? Tristan escapes the nightmare after defeating The Heart, right?

[img]https://i.imgur.com/klYWSyP.png[/img]

... Well, in Ultimate Nightmare mode, things go a bit differently. We won't spoil everything, but the basic premise for the post-game is that, instead of leaving, Tristan teams up with The Heart to kill the entity that created the realm of monsters. At the same time, The Guide goes missing. It's up to Tristan to find The Guide, discover the truth, and bring an end to the nightmare once and for all.

[/spoiler]

All of these improvements, balancing, and quality of life features are great... but that's not all Ultimate Edition has. We won't show our full hand just yet, but there's a new, powerful threat in the game. A brand new boss accessible in a secret area within the hospital's walls...

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sPsmL7R.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RnzWZhS.png[/img]

... We'll go into a bit more detail on that later. For now; thank you for reading.

[hr][/hr]
Be sure to let us know what you think on [url=https://discord.gg/7w76buDUEE]our Discord[/url]. [url=https://x.com/ReframeGames]Follow us on X[/url] for more updates.

notes.title: Devlog #2: Bringing Some Balance
notes.content:
🎃 Happy Halloween, horror fans!🎃 

This new devlog is certainly a treat. Take a look at upcoming improvements to Souls, game balance, and UI coming to Noxia Somnia: Ultimate Edition in January 2025.

[b][h1]General Updates to Souls[/h1][/b]

A number of improvements and tweaks to souls are coming in Ultimate Edition: 

[list]
[*] The Soul of Recovery is 100% automated! No more need to re-equip a healing item into your quickslot every time you want to use it. This Soul will now activate the strongest healing item available in your inventory on a lethal blow. You’ll also get about 5 seconds of invincibility after the healing as a buffer against extra-heavy hits. 
[/list]

[video]https://i.imgur.com/iFjFSXZ.mp4[i][/i][/video]

[list]
[*] Now with the Soul of Strength, if Athleticism II is unlocked, Tristan ignores all damage knockback/stun. It’s kind of incredible! No more hits in the knockback animation 🙅‍♂️
[/list]

[video]https://i.imgur.com/TB3nLkc.mp4[i][/i][/video]

[list]
[*] Felt like the Soul of Determination was in the F-Tier thanks to long heal times? Those days are over! Now, this Soul heads based on a % of your max health rather than a flat 10 HP, making it a much more viable option in late-game encounters. 
[/list]

[video]https://i.imgur.com/JBDKI3U.mp4[i][/i][/video]

[list]
[*] The damage reduction from the Soul of Endurance has been increased from 20% to 25%.
[*] We’ve doubled down on risk vs. reward with the Soul of Perseverance. You’ll no longer drop your attack combo from taking stress damage, but your defence is lowered the higher your combo is. Getting a higher combo feels pretty awesome now… but when you mess up, it hurts. 
[*] Alright, we’ll admit it: Soul of Security was a bit useless in 1.0. It only boosted your defense at whole health, so you were…extra healthy. Now, when you’re below half health, you’ll get a massive defence boost. 
[*] Soul of Bravery has been given some love too. It no longer requires 100% HP for its damage buff to be active, and is given as long as the player stays above 50% HP, giving more room for error in play.
[/list]

[b][h2]Ultimate Nightmare-Exclusive Soul Updates[/h2][/b]

These Souls are only accessible when playing the Ultimate Nightmare difficulty mode in Ultimate Edition: 

[list]
[*] The Soul of Tranquility is a new Soul that increases your attack power the more stress you have. Another risk vs. reward playstyle option that is very dangerous (and powerful) to use. Not for the faint of heart. 
[*] The Soul of Acceptance is another new Soul that converts stress into health over time. 
[*] The Soul of Fortitude and the Soul of Insight are two more new souls that relate to the new Reframe ability coming in Ultimate Edition. It’s a secret for now!
[/list]

[h1][b]Balance Updates, Part 1[/b][/h1]

We have so many balance updates, that we’ll be doing a Part 2 in our next devlog! For now, here’s some big improvements coming to Ultimate Edition: 

[list]
[*] The Eye Slime will no longer shoot at the player while off screen. They will try to stay on screen, but outside of melee range when possible.
[*] The Eye Slime's projectile now glows to make it easier to see.
[/list]

[video]https://i.imgur.com/RPe9WdX.mp4[/video]

[list]
[*] The Clockwork Minion's attack range has been increased. They will no longer miss every single attack like a goober.
[/list]

[video]https://i.imgur.com/lCEWZ0Y.mp4[/video]

[list]
[*] Tristan's attacks are much faster and responsive. We've also made it a bit easier to execute charged attacks. Take a look at the revamped combat in the short clip below, alongside a preview of one of the boss rematches that can be encountered in Ultimate Nightmare mode...
[/list]

[video]https://i.imgur.com/o5PlFsl.mp4[/video]

[h1][b]UI Updates [/b][/h1]

With help from our fans’ feedback, we’ve made some great improvements to the game’s user interface. Multiple icons have been redrawn to read more clearly for Ultimate Edition, and we’ve added new on-screen indicators that help make it clear when different health and status effects are occurring.

We will continue refining the game's user interface as we move closer and closer to launch day. For now, here are a few of Ultimate's item icons. A few familiar items, and a few new items with an updated coat of paint!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5RDwQwu.png[/img]

[h1][b]Chapter 1 Demo Now Available[/b][/h1]

🥁 And now a drum roll please for today’s biggest update…

Our free demo for Chapter 1 of Noxia Somnia: Ultimate Edition is available! A familiar setting has been given an all-new look and feel. Try out the Ultimate Nightmare game mode, test out new abilities, and try not to perish! Note that this demo link is public for a limited time. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2570120/Noxia_Somnia_Ultimate_Edition_Demo/][h2][b]→ TRY THE DEMO HERE ←[/b][/h2][/url]

Be sure to let us know what you think on our [url=discord.gg/7w76buDUEE]Discord[/url]. Follow us on [url=https://x.com/NoxiaGame]X[/url] for more updates.

notes.title: Devlog #1: Shiny New Updates
notes.content:
[h3][b]Welcome to our first dev log for Noxia Somnia: Ultimate Edition! We’re planning to release these development updates monthly as we journey towards our February 2025 release date. [/b][/h3]

Going into Ultimate Edition we had one major goal: to take the player’s experience to the next level, whether it was your first time playing or the 50th. That’s why you’ll see many quality of life improvements across our enemies, fast travel, and lighting in Ultimate Edition that greatly improve the base game experience.[i] (We’ll chat more about our new difficulty mode for seasoned players called Ultimate Nightmare in a later dev log!).[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Lighting Enhancements[/h1]

Understanding the critical role atmosphere plays in horror game design, we recognized that enhancing our lighting system could significantly elevate the overall feel of Noxia.

[video]https://i.imgur.com/AaFB6HC.mp4[/video]

As you can see here, we’ve given rooms a more realistic, foggy effect with volumetric lighting. Rooms that used to be pitch-dark now have more depth. 

[h3]Old room lighting[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/P8kmT4i.png[/img]

[h3]New room lighting [/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/PbdzFNa.png[/img]

Pickups have been given additional lighting effects and particles, and Tristain’s flashlight has been given a stronger battery (more volumetric lighting). Lens flares have been added or improved for many objects.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ggDNX7I.png[/img]

Certain sprites now react more realistically to light, giving certain objects like our vending machines a glowy Look. Glass and metallic surfaces have also been reworked to have a better shine.

[h3]Old vending machine[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/9Bttbxk.png[/img]

[h3]New vending machine[/h3] 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/IJer1hg.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Enemy Improvements[/h1]

For the base game release, some enemy ideas didn’t quite make the final cut. One of those was our Bully frenemy here, who got stuck with a recycled NPC design. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qtf0qMc.png[/img]

We’re happy to share that the Bully is now…the fearsome Bruiser!

[video]https://i.imgur.com/vkZfL9R.mp4[/video]

The Scholar has also been given the menacing design it deserves.

[video]https://i.imgur.com/m0SNsxW.mp4[/video]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Fast Travel[/h1]

Now when you use a portal, you’ll be given a menu of all the destinations in an act that you can travel to. You can go to any portal that you’ve unlocked which cuts down on back tracking (it was kind of boring). 

[video]https://i.imgur.com/fPIeUOI.mp4[/video]

[hr][/hr]
That’s all we have to share for now, but there’s more to come soon! You can always [url=https://x.com/NoxiaGame]follow Noxia Somnia on X[/url] / [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@noxiasomniathegame]TikTok[/url] and join our [url=discord.gg/7w76buDUEE]Reframe Games Discord[/url] to stay connected with the community in the meantime. 

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Noxia Somnia Update v1.1
notes.content:
We've got a new update releasing today for Noxia Somnia, the biggest one being adding a new language: French!

📜 Text

- The game's text system has been completely reworked from the ground up. Improved performance, support for multiple languages, and more.
- New Language: French! The language menu can be opened on the title screen, and players can now pick between English and French. Additional languages will be added in future updates.
- When playing with French language, guillemets should be used consistently instead of quotation marks.
- A large amount of dialogue has been rewritten so that it flows more naturally, and has a bit more personality. Robotic sounding lines have been removed or reworked. These rewrites affect the entire game.
- Some tutorials and button text have been simplified so that they are more understandable at a glance.
- All instances of text overlapping other menu icons have been resolved.



🐛 Resolved Bugs

- Major Bugfix; Certain text elements no longer duplicate when you die or reload the game.
- All instances of the "There is an item ahead!" debug text loading for tutorials have been fixed.
- The player can no longer turn the flashlight on and off when in the skill tree menu, this should prevent any instances of controls locking up due to bugged animation states.
- Any instances where the skill tree menu broke and could not be used should be fixed now.
- The save file delete menu no longer uses the UI from the pre-alpha builds of Noxia. (How did this even happen?)
- Rare item popup missing text bug fixed.



📢 Audio & Music

- When the game is paused, the player's heartbeat sound is reduced in volume. This should make it less annoying when inputting safe codes, reading, or browsing your inventory.
- Rain on roof ambience in the hub world now scale based on your "Effects" volume setting instead of blasting at max volume when the game is muted.
- Final boss ambience and other sound effects now scale based on sound effect volume setting.
- The song "Chez Pierre" now scales based on music volume.



⚙️ Optimization

- Heartbeat monitor code optimized. It probably doesn't need to update every single frame, right?
- Event Checks & Room Detection no longer run on fixed time for slightly improved performance.



🎨 Graphical Adjustments & Fixes

- A variety of decorations in Act 1 and 2 were improved.
- Appearance of the Culinary Room in Act 1 was changed.
- Some minor adjustments were made to the final boss's visuals. This includes overhauled lighting, new warning indicators for their slam attack, and indicators for when the shield around their heart is vulnerable.



⚖️ Balance Adjustments

- The health of the final boss was reduced by roughly 40% on all modes to reduce the difficulty of the battle.
- The final boss's claw slam attack now deals a set amount of damage rather than each hand doing a specific amount of damage.
- The final boss no longer summons Shades of Life or Bullies.



🎮 Controls

- Custom keybinds have been replaced with a more complex and easy to use preset system. This change was made in the minor patch 1.0.2, and has been improved for 1.1's release.
- Applying control presets is now done automatically when exiting the menu instead of having to manually select "apply" after picking your preset.
- If an input device disconnects during gameplay, the game will now automatically pause. 



💻 UI

- The settings menu has been redesigned. It now looks a lot better, and text within the menu has been simplified so it is easier to understand.
- The game mode select screen was simplified a bit.
- The control menu was simplified a bit as well.
- On 16:10 / Steam Deck handheld mode, tutorial prompts on the skill tree are no longer offscreen.
- Text on the skill tree is no longer cut off by the (invisible) preview video for skills.
- The phone pause screen now scales correctly on 16:10 and 21:9 ultrawide resolutions.
- Collectable display UI now starts at it's default position when opening a menu instead of being scrolled down slightly.



💀 Known Issues

- There is a known bug with input devices where you cannot connect one mid-game. If you are having trouble connecting a controller, try connecting it prior to launching the game and making sure it does not disconnect during loading screens. This will be a priority fix for next update.
- During Pierre's introduction scene, one of his dialogue boxes incorrectly is displayed over Tristan.
- There may be issues with certain lines of text in this update due to the extensive changes made to the text system, please let us know if you find any.



Thanks for the support and for playing Noxia Somnia!

notes.title: Noxia Somnia v.1.0.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43487169/5875057da8413eb8e418e881dd71f3a39656cc71.png[/img]
We've got a new update releasing today for Noxia Somnia! This update should address most of the bugs and other issues found in the 1.0 release.


[b]🐛 Major Resolved Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] The "Time Is Key" puzzle in Act 1 has been improved. The clocks in the hall now emit a more obvious glow, and the third clock is now loaded properly in the locker room.
[*] A major error was found with the progression/item flag system. Certain collectables and items could be picked up repeatedly by reloading your save. This resulted in duplicate collectable items, infinite espresso pickups, etc. We've made some changes to try and fix these issues, but save files from the 1.0 version may still have glitched items.
[/list]

[b]🐛 Resolved Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] The expensive coffee item can now be purchased.
[*] Certain crates in Act 3 that did not drop shards or coins are now fixed.
[*] Certain room on the first floor of Act 2 will no longer render multiple instances at once.
[*] Tristan's outfit now updates correctly during the intro to Act 2 and when you die.
[*] Actions that give Tristan a trail being cancelled by taking damage or other means will no longer infinitely keep the trail.
[*] Player no longer takes stress damage after being killed.
[*] Shades of Life enemy in Act 2 can now hit the player more than once.
[/list]

[b]💪 Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] When attempting to perform a Charged Slash + Lunge, the game now checks if the player has the Lunge ability unlocked or not.
[*] Toggling the flashlight can no longer interrupt the Charged Slash animation.
[*] Charged Slash & Charged Slash + Lunge can now be used with the flashlight out.
[*] Collectables now have a bit of extra space near the bottom to prevent certain letters from being cut off.
[*] Extra items spawn at the end of The Graduate arena if the player chooses to backtrack there.
[*] The skill tree now displays the player's shard count and unlocked mementos in the bottom left of the screen.
[*] Prerequisites the player has not met on the skill tree are now greyed out. The color of the text will change if the player meets the requirement.
[*] The vent in the second safe room in Act 3 now has a light next to it, making it more obvious to new players.
[*] Fixed some sprite layering issues in the Post-Finale hub world.
[*] Text has more room to wrap & write out in shop menu item descriptions.
[*] High stress levels now make borders appear in the corners of the screen. They go away when the player turns the flashlight on.
[*] Some typos in the script have been fixed.
[/list]

[b]⚖️ Balance Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Stress healing was increased on Face Your Fears.
[*] On Face Your Fears, chases now end faster.
[*] Stress can no longer kill the player on Face Your Fears mode. It will bring them down to 10 HP, but will not kill as long as they player can avoid taking damage.
[*] Additionally, stress damage was reduced on Face Your Fears.
[*] The player's damage boost on Face Your Fears mode was reduced a little bit.
[*] Act 2 boss health was increased slightly on all modes.
[*] Upgraded cat summon's speed was reduced slightly.
[*] The bell in the Boutique Shop now explodes if you ring it 10 times.
[*] The player no longer takes stress damage when their flashlight is on, unless being chased.
[*] Final boss health reduced on all modes.
[*] Shades of Life enemy in Act 2 deals a bit less damage.
[/list]

[b]🎨 Graphical[/b]
[list]
[*] New item icons for the Pocket Watch, Espresso, Cat Food, Scholar/Clockwork/Slime Whistle.
[*] Shading enhancements for the Energy Drink, Elevator Button, Wire Cutters.
[*] Summoned version of the Clockwork Minion now appears blue in color to help them stand out from the other Clockwork Minions.
[*] Summoned version of the Scholar now has a red gown + a blue eye for the same reason as above.
[*] Summoned version of the Eye Slime now has a fur hat for the same reason as above.
[/list]


Additionally, we are aware of a bug with keybinds not being saved properly. We'll be looking for a fix for this bug ASAP. We are also still hard at work on the Ultimate Nightmare content update, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Noxia Somnia 1.0
notes.content:
Hello,

Creative director on Noxia Somnia here. It is surreal to finally see this game released. It's been such a long journey creating Noxia and I'd like to thank everyone for their support. We couldn't have done it without you, and I hope the 1.0 release lives up to the hype.

We'll be monitoring feedback on the game as closely as we can and making fixes and improvements to any issues that pop up. We also have a community Discord! If you run into any significant issues, you can contact us here:

[url=https://discord.gg/zCPxEEEXJM]https://discord.gg/zCPxEEEXJM[/url]

For post-launch, we plan on localizing the game in a few different languages, and adding the hard mode/post-game content that is "Ultimate Nightmare." No specific dates yet, though.

For now, please enjoy Noxia Somnia! If you want to help support us even further, share the game with your friends or family.

notes.title: Update: Demo Build V4!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43487169/4e977c06da52aa647661b99ffdea18a690c2d8f6.png[/img]

New version update today thanks to all our play testers! 
 
🐛 Resolved Bugs
[list]
[*] Cafeteria scene in the intro should no longer be blurred/obscured when returning after dying or reloading the game.
[*] The item in the safe in the kitchen will no longer render behind the safe when opened.
[*] The entrance to the school area in the intro will no longer despawn if you die to Overwhelming Anxiety.
[*] Increased Tristan's worker sprite by 1 pixel on the Y axis so that he no longer clips into the floor.
[/list]

💪 Improvements
[list]
[*] All UI properly scales and works on Steam Deck. ːsteamthumbsupː
[*] Checkpoints in the intro are now properly shown to the player through "damaged portals" placed in the prologue.
[*] Player can now use multiple items at once in the inventory without it closing each time.
[*] If the player is not carrying any items, there is now text for empty inventory.
[*] Using the flashlight from the inventory will toggle it in-game to avoid confusion.
[*] Save notification now says "PROGRESS SAVED."
[*] Added a brief interactable cinematic near the end of the chase that happens in the intro.
[*] Hallway that you are chased through in the intro has more decorations now.
[*] Visuals in second half of Act 1 were improved significantly.
[*] Added a prompt that indicates when a character is finished talking.
[*] Player can now attack in "cinematic" areas. (Not sure why we restricted attacking in these areas anyway, it was causing some confusion among play testers and you can't really break anything in these areas anyway...)
[*] Flashback scene that occurs after the first real boss no longer lets you walk to the right
[*] Graduate fireball was rebalanced. SFX was changed when they hit the ground, added VFX for spawning and de-spawning as well as a warning line to indicate trajectory.
[*] Textbox shading was improved
[/list]

📜 Text Changes
[list]
[*] Unlock condition for Ultimate Nightmare was changed from "complete on normal" to "Complete demo on "The Nightmare" mode".
[*] Ghost 1 in the intro now has 3 question marks to be consistent with Ghost 2.
[*] Interact tutorial text has been changed to be less confusing.
[*] You can interact with the door at the end of the first hallway in the prologue now.
[*] Fixed some typos on the descriptions in the settings menu. Added a note about screen tearing when not using VSync in full screen.
[*] Very minor changes to dialogue throughout the demo area (make some wording less confusing)
[*] Taser short circuiting is now mentioned in the taser tutorial so people aren't as confused by it.
[/list]

⚖️ Balance Adjustments
[list]
[*] Graduate boss fight has been extensively rebalanced across all modes. (Mostly easier.)
[*] The Graduate's tornado attack has been temporarily removed.
[*] The Nightmare has been made easier. (Taken damage is reduced by 20% across the board. Certain enemies are slower.)
[*] Face Your Fears, Graduate's attacks are now slower.
[*] Ultimate Nightmare boss fights made significantly harder. (New attacks, much higher speed...)
[/list]


If you would like to join the community our discord: https://discord.gg/63HnCSrA

notes.title: Update: Demo Build V3!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43487169/5875057da8413eb8e418e881dd71f3a39656cc71.png[/img]

New version update today thanks to all our play testers! 
 
⚖️ Overall Balance Adjustments
•	Drop rates for common monster items were increased. (30% > 80%)
•	The "Bully" enemy type now has a rare item drop. (Medkit, about a 10% chance.)
•	The range on all weapons has been buffed by about 15%.
•	Flashlight heals stress faster on all modes.
•	The first boss now drops Experience Shards and Coins when killed.
•	Helpful items have been placed around Act 1, and some existing items have been relocated.
•	Consumable invulnerability window has been reduced. (0.5s > 0.3s)
•	Default stamina recharge rate increased by 5/s on all modes.
•	Stress healing base value is increased by roughly 5-10% to make stress management easier.
•	The clocks for the "Time Is Key" puzzle now glow.
•	Hitting crates with melee weapons is no longer framerate dependent. 

🔦 Face Your Fears Adjustments
•	Stress heals an additional 10% faster on Face Your Fears.
👿 Nightmare Mode Adjustments
•	Player takes 20% less damage on Nightmare now.
💀 Ultimate Nightmare Mode Adjustments
•	Player takes 275% damage now instead of 250%.
•	IFrames reduced from 0.2s to 0.15s.
•	Stress heals an additional 10% faster on Ultimate Nightmare.

🐛 Resolved Bugs
•	Soul of Recovery is now working as intended.
•	Calm Mind I will no longer increase the stress that the player takes.
•	Fixed an incorrect prompt in the key bind menu.
•	Most menus now work on 16:10 aspect ratio.
•	At 200+ FPS, hitting crates with melee weapons should be more consistent. 
•	Graduate can no longer be despawned in the first part of Act 1 by going through specific doors.
•	The Graduate will no longer cancel entering a door due to Level 2 Exposure Status.
•	Additionally, the "close door" sound for the AI is much more obvious now.
•	The Graduate's AI is improved and they will no longer camp the Teacher's Lounge.
•	Summons (Greg, Scholar) will no longer attack enemies while they should be frozen.
•	Soul of Vigor will no longer provide health regeneration when interacting with objects.
•	Summon: Scholar can now hit moving enemies more consistently.
•	Player can now pet the Greg summon.
•	Tristan's movement speed calculation with certain skills was incorrect, and has been fixed.

 🎨 Graphical Adjustments & Fixes
•	Floating tutorial keyboard prompts now fade out.
•	Sprite masking error in intro forest has been fixed.
•	Using the taser now short circuits the flashlight for a few seconds.
•	HUD improved. 
•	Act 1 decorative objects improved. (Science Lab cabinets, tables, sink,  speakers, etc.)
•	Lamps can be toggled on and off by interacting with them.
•	Visual indicator has been added for taser charge.
•	Taser will not charge or play the sound when you do not have the taser module in your inventory.
•	Exposure Gauge, Settings menu now have animations for entry.
•	Safe has full SFX, as well as prompts now.
•	New red glow near the exposure meter that indicates how close the monster is to the player.
•	Stress is much more obvious now (There is a glow from the HUD that intensifies as stress increases. At 50%, it prompts to enable the flashlight)
•	Collectables and Soul pickups are now much more obvious. (They appear as a larger, separate notification with the ability for the player to hold inventory to show the menu they are in.)
•	Interact prompts now have some animations for fading in.
•	Added a prompt on the main menu.
•	Tristan has a new effect for when the taser is charged.

📜 Text
•	The voices that talk while Tristan is unconscious in the first scene now have voices.
•	When the teacher is transforming into The Graduate, their name now changes as intended.
•	Tutorial in Act 1 adjusted, player is no longer told to upgrade before they unlock the ability to.
•	A reminder about turning off the light to attack has been added outside the school.
•	Added a tutorial about the different types of item pickups in the intro.
•	Weird pause in the Prologue's cafeteria scene fixed.
•	Guide not spawning before talking in acrobat soul scene fixed.
•	"Death" changed to "Regret"
•	"Miscellaneous" changed to "Other"
•	A lot of collectables have been rewritten. (Bloodstained Note, Old Essay, Worn Scissors, etc.)
•	More scenes, and a significant amount of dialogue, have changed in Ultimate Nightmare mode.
•	Ultimate Nightmare no longer tells the player that fighting the patrolling monster is an option.
•	Some text color changed from Dark Blue to Light Blue to be more readable.

🎸 Music
•	The song "The Occulted Ones" now plays during the first boss fight in Act 1.

🏫 Level Design
•	Merchant now sells "School Safe Codes", and safes have been added that contain helpful items.
•	You can now interact with most of the lamps in the intro. 💡
